title: The Resignation Incident
summary: Describes the circumstances surrounding the signing of the resignation letter by the appellant and the discussions that preceded it.
content: Late in the afternoon of 19 May 1994 the appellant was called to Mr Mahoney’s office again and re-interviewed by two security consultants engaged by the respondent, a Mr Jeffrey and a Ms Iverach, in relation to the radio. At that time officers of the respondent suspected that the appellant had committed an act of dishonesty. Mr Mahoney and a Mr Callaghan (the immediate superiors of the appellant) were present at the interview at various stages. As a result of what transpired at the interview, as well as subsequent discussions which occurred between the appellant and Ms Sharon Horn (the personnel officer of the respondent), the appellant’s employment with the respondent came to an end. Immediately after the abovementioned discussions Ms Horn returned to her office to prepare a letter of resignation that was to be signed by the appellant.
